title: Chapter 649 - 649 Anticipation; Barbecue!
content:
Chapter 649 - 649 Anticipation; Barbecue!

Chapter 649 - 649 Anticipation; Barbecue!

649 Anticipation; Barbecue!

Finally, Xia Xue took the food and put it into her mouth. The food was so delicious, and she was extremely satisfied.

The students sitting not far away seemed to smell the fragrance and looked at Xia Xue.

Soon, everyone’s eyes were fixed on her.

They were taking in nutrient fluids and eating compressed biscuits and bread… They even thought that the taste was pretty good.

However, at this moment, they suddenly felt that the things they had were not good at all.

…

In the live broadcast room.

Stupid Child: [The difference between people is really big.]

Who First Saw the Moon: [The students’ eyes are a little red.]

Beggar: [Having a boyfriend is good.]

Flower in the Heart: [I suddenly want to date again.]

…

Xia Xue had just finished eating a delicious meal. She casually glanced at the live broadcast room, and her entire pretty face instantly blushed.

Boyfriend?

She stole a glance at Lin Fan before lowering her head.

…

After resting for about 20 minutes, the students stood up and set off again.

Along the way, there were tall trees and jagged rocks…

At this moment, a long green snake suddenly fell from the tree and landed on a woman with coiled hair.

“Help!” the woman shouted in panic.

Li Dongqiang’s reaction was extremely fast. He stepped forward and pinched the seven-inch snake.

Then, he pulled out the dagger at his waist and slashed down.

Blood splattered as the snake’s head fell to the ground.

Li Dongqiang had good skills, and he had gained five pounds of strength previously.

Catching the snake and slashing the snake were easy for him.

The woman with her hair tied up froze on the spot for a while.

After a long time, she came back to her senses and said sincerely, “Thank you, Li Dongqiang. Thank you.”

As she spoke, her eyes were misty.

Obviously, she was indeed frightened.

Li Dongqiang smiled. “Yes, yes. Just say thank you. It’s best to say it a few more times.”

That was because a crisp notification sounded in his mind.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received two gratitude tokens. You can use them for the lucky draw.]

Two gratitude tokens!

That was right!

She said thank you twice!

Not long ago, Li Dongqiang had already used a gratitude token to obtain 5 pounds’ worth of strength. Naturally, the more gratitude tokens he received, the better.

The woman, who was originally extremely afraid and grateful, burst out laughing.

The fear and gratitude from before had faded a lot.

“Thank you,” the woman said.

However, Li Dongqiang did not receive any gratitude tokens this time.

This made Li Dongqiang a little disappointed.

Then, he turned his attention to the gratitude tokens.

‘Use them!’

[Ding! It’s a pity that you didn’t get anything.]

The corner of Li Dongqiang’s mouth twitched slightly. So, there was a chance to not get anything?

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve gained three pounds’ worth of strength.]

Three pounds worth of strength?

Although it was less than five pounds, it was still not bad.

A smile appeared on Li Dongqiang’s face.

“There are many snakes, insects, rats, ants, ferocious beasts, and even mutated beasts in the forbidden area! Everyone, pay attention to your safety.”

…

The students continued to move forward.

Li Dongqiang was not only paying attention to whether anyone would fall down, but he was also paying attention to whether any snakes, insects, rats, or ants would suddenly appear.

Opportunity was always given to those who were prepared.

In the following period of time, two bumblebees and a snake appeared.

All of them were taken care of by Li Dongqiang.

As a result, Li Dongqiang received the gratitude of four people and successfully received four gratitude tokens.

These four gratitude tokens increased Li Dongqiang’s strength by 12 pounds’ worth.

In other words, in just one day, Li Dongqiang’s strength had increased by 20 pounds’ worth!

Even after walking in the forest for an entire day, Li Dongqiang was still full of energy.

The setting sun dyed the distant sky bright red.

“The forbidden area isn’t safe at night,” Zhang Fen said. “Let’s rest here.”

At this moment, everyone was already exhausted. They sat down and sighed.

“I’m so tired.”

“My legs are a little weak.”

“My legs feel like jelly.”

“Sigh, there are still six days left.”

…

In the beginning, everyone was full of ambition. They wanted to find the legendary treasures in the forbidden area and fly to higher places.

However, after a day, they no longer had any hope.

The students complained as they took out water and food to replenish their strength.

Just like in the afternoon, Lin Fan took out another set of delicious food.

“Xia Xue, come and eat,” Lin Fan said.

A thousand years ago, every time Xia Xue and Xia Bing met, they prepared an energy drink for Lin Fan.

A thousand years later, it was Lin Fan who prepared food for Xia Xue!

Xia Xue smelled these delicacies, and her stomach immediately made a rumbling sound.

She could not help but say, “Okay… Alright.”

After eating the delicious food, she felt that the fatigue in her entire body seemed to have dissipated a lot.

Actually, this was the truth.

Because when Xia Xue was eating, Lin Fan secretly injected her with life energy.

After Xia Xue had a full meal, her entire pretty face was full of satisfaction.

A man with a buzz cut called Zheng Cong asked in confusion, “Lin Fan, I’m afraid the food you brought won’t be able to last long. What will you do for the next few days?”

At this moment, a large bird about a meter long flew over the treetops.

Then, as if the bird was tired of flying or had a heart attack, it fell straight from the sky and made a dull sound. Then, it was completely silent.
